summary: Frontend-only UI verification of two new admin features: (1) filtered export on Laporan & Rekap and (2) admin kader password reset. All 9 export buttons render, kelurahan filter select + active-filter chip + reset chip work, CSV download for keluarga is triggered (file: laporan_keluarga.csv) and success toast 'Laporan CSV diunduh' appears. Reset kader password modal opens with prefilled 'kader123', short password (<6) is rejected and modal stays open, valid 'tempReset9' closes modal and shows toast referencing kader3 + tempReset9. Re-login as kader3/tempReset9 verified via backend (Playwright logout on kader UI is via bottom-nav Profil, not top-level 'Keluar'). kader3 password restored to 'kader123'. Final sanity: admin/admin123, kader1/kader123, kader3/kader123 all authenticate 200.

issues: Recharts container renders with width(-1)/height(-1) on first paint producing many console warnings (cosmetic, chart still renders correctly)

critical_code_review_comments: Consider giving the sidebar 'Keluar' (logout) button a stable data-testid (e.g., btn-logout) — this simplifies automated UI tests and cross-role logout flows.
Recharts <ResponsiveContainer> is emitting width(-1)/height(-1) warnings — likely a parent with height:100% but no explicit min-height. Setting min-height on the chart wrapper will silence the noise.
Optionally add data-testid to individual kader rows (e.g., kader-row-kader3) so tests don't need DOM walking to correlate username <-> reset button.
test_credentials: admin/admin123, kader1..kader10/kader123 (kader3 restored to kader123 at end of run — verified 200 via /api/auth/login)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (filtered export + reset kader password) work end-to-end in the UI. kader3 was temporarily reset to tempReset9 during testing and then restored to kader123 via POST /api/admin/kader/{uid}/reset-password — verified with a follow-up successful login. Note: the kader3 role does not surface a top-level 'Keluar' button in the header/sidebar (it lives inside the mobile-style bottom-nav Profil tab). If you need to logout a kader in Playwright, use context.clear_cookies() + navigate to /login rather than clicking 'Keluar'.
rca of the issue: n/a — no product bugs found in this iteration.
